response.sql: SELECT i.invoice_number, AVG(CASE WHEN ili.derived_product_cost > 0 THEN ili.derived_total_cost / ili.derived_product_cost ELSE NULL END) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(ili.order_item_id) AS line_item_count FROM Invoices i LEFT JOIN Invoice_Line_Items ili ON i.invoice_number = ili.invoice_number GROUP BY i.invoice_number ORDER BY line_item_count DESC LIMIT 10;
